description.en: A funnel-shaped concentric sediment fill wraps a narrow central tunnel.

scientific_scope.en: Stylized trace-morphology concept. The ichnogenus names the trace, not its producer; sediment surfaces and cross-sections are illustrative. Listed periods refer to source examples, not the complete range.

modeling_brief.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: a funnel-shaped concentric sediment fill wraps a narrow central tunnel. description.en: A main axis bears divided lateral sprays with paired elongate sporangia.
description.zh: 主轴生出分裂侧枝簇，带成对长形孢子囊。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Psilophyton dawsonii; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Psilophyton dawsonii 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Hierarchical lateral sprays replace the equal Y-forks of Cooksonia; it is not a leafy fern.
distinctness.zh: 分级侧枝簇区别于Cooksonia的等分Y枝，并非有叶真蕨。

modeling_brief.en: Give the central axis visual dominance and grouped end-pairs; use no broad leaf planes.
modeling_brief.zh: 突出中央主轴与成组顶端囊对，不加入宽叶面。

assets.uncertainty: Fertile branching is better documented than exact basal habit.
